write_up: Your resume points toward operations management: you now run terminal operations at Brightline Freight Partners, after program roles at Google and Dell Technologies. It’s common for a current role to be described as duties, but these lines won’t stand out in a pile because a recruiter can’t tell how much the terminal handles or what your work has changed.

The Google line about cutting the forecast-to-delivery cycle is your model: it names the work, the change, and how you achieved it. Your earlier roles give a recruiter a concrete picture of your work; the current one doesn’t yet give them the same picture.

Let’s start with the Brightline role. Add what the terminal handles and the size of your team, then name the issues you resolve and the metrics you report. Use numbers and results you can support, rather than trying to force one into every line.
